answer_4.quote: we conducted a user study with 11 participants (8 males, 3 females, 1 non-binary) with an age range of 21-65. Each listened to six random conversations from the Candor dataset, experiencing both the original mixture and the model output in a random order.
answer_4.guideline: we asked participants four 5-point scale questions about their experience in focusing on the target conversation
